description: Fork of exp515 (tied LUT unembedder, hilr recipe that got the tie working: aux_top1 reached 91% by step 1000). ONLY change: unemb_tph 16 -> 128 (unembedder 0.52M -> 4.2M vote weights). exp515 showed bpb stalled/rose (~2.8) even as aux_top1 climbed -> the tie is not the bottleneck; the head's CANDIDATE COVERAGE is (only ~tph tokens get nonzero logits per prediction). tph=128 gives 128 candidate tokens/prediction (8x) AND makes per-token logits context-dependent via vote counts. Test: if bpb drops meaningfully vs exp515, coverage was the limit; if it stays ~2.8, the fixed-per-cell-magnitude limit / embedder-conflict is fundamental. Everything else identical to exp515.
